$comment: Flip2 setup wizard download catalog. Every hash below was computed from the real upstream file (sha256sum), not guessed; sizes are exact byte counts. The browser verifies each download with WebCrypto SHA-256 against these pins before anything is pushed to the phone. Nothing in this catalog is stored in the repo or attached to releases — these are pointers to upstream artifacts.

files.purpose: Custom boot image (root boot). Flashed to the boot partition ONLY, and only after the user unlocks the bootloader — a step that erases the phone. Never flash super, vbmeta, system, product, or the preloader; never write the EMMC_BOOT header. neutron-noavb.img is NOT used.
files.author: neutronscott (flip2 project)

files.purpose: Flip2 single-shot Magisk installer (full tier): installs user APKs (launcher4, Null Keyboard), downloads external APKs (Forkgram, Material Files), unpacks the flip2 Magisk modules, applies baked settings (home-keys, the 321x428 logical size) and the default wallpaper, then self-removes. Matches release v1.2.0-flip2.
files.author: MRsmallAgain (flip2 project)

files.purpose: Forkgram messenger (Telegram fork) patched for the Flip 2's small screen and keypad.
files.author: Forkgram / MRsmallAgain patch

files.purpose: whisper.cpp ggml tiny model (q5_1), used for speech-to-text by the Flip2 Null Keyboard IME. Copied to files/whisper/en/model.bin AND files/whisper/uk/model.bin (one multilingual bin serves both languages).
files.license: MIT (whisper.cpp); model weights per OpenAI whisper terms
files.author: whisper.cpp (ggerganov)

files.purpose: Headwind MDM launcher, versionCode 15400. Managed profile only. Installing this APK does not make it device owner; that is a separate step after the user types manage, and only when the phone has no accounts. There is no download URL: Companion matches a local file by this SHA-256. Device owner uses com.hmdm.launcher/.AdminReceiver from this build.
files.author: h-mdm

files.purpose: Where location app, versionName 2026.10.14.2, versionCode 1471, armeabi-v7a. Managed profile only. The Flip2 is 32-bit ARM; x86_64 and arm64-v8a builds fail with INSTALL_FAILED_NO_MATCHING_ABIS. Install via Flip2 Apply before device owner when using no_install_apps in Headwind. Local pin by SHA-256.
files.author: danmarg
